# hardened-runtime — templates

## §1 Per-tenant scope drop-in (generated by setup)

```bash
# setup_host.sh (excerpt) — base units grant NO tenant data roots; this drop-in does.
# Layout: /srv/app-data/<tenant>/{raw,canonical,decisions,run_outputs}
own="/srv/app-data/$SCOPE"
install -d -o app -g app "$own" "$own/raw" "$own/canonical" "$own/decisions" "$own/run_outputs"
for unit in app-web capture@ derive@; do
  dropin="/etc/systemd/system/${unit}.service.d"
  mkdir -p "$dropin"
  {
    echo "[Service]"
    case "$unit" in
      capture@) echo "ReadWritePaths=$own/raw" ;;                 # captures write evidence only
      derive@)  echo "ReadWritePaths=$own/canonical $own/run_outputs" ;;
      app-web)  echo "ReadWritePaths=$own/decisions $own/canonical $own/run_outputs"
                echo "ReadOnlyPaths=$own/raw" ;;
    esac
    for root in /srv/app-data/*/; do
      root="${root%/}"
      [ "$root" = "$own" ] || echo "InaccessiblePaths=-$root"
    done
  } > "$dropin/10-scope.conf"
done
systemctl daemon-reload
```

## §2 Templated capture + chained derivation + separate delivery

```ini
# capture@.service — instance = the slot (%i)
[Unit]
Description=Capture source data for slot %i
OnFailure=app-alert@%n.service
# Wants, never Requires: a failing watchdog can't block us
Wants=tunnel-watchdog.service
After=network-online.target tunnel-watchdog.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=app
EnvironmentFile=/etc/app/app.env
ExecStart=/opt/app/.venv/bin/python -m app.capture --slot %i
ExecStartPost=-+/usr/bin/systemctl start --wait derive@%i.service
TimeoutStartSec=15min
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
# + the tenant's raw/ dir, granted by the 10-scope drop-in (§1)
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/app/locks
```
```ini
# capture@morning.timer
[Timer]
OnCalendar=Mon..Sat *-*-* 08:45:00 Europe/Berlin
OnCalendar=Mon..Sat *-*-* 09:05..55/10:00 Europe/Berlin
AccuracySec=1s
Persistent=true
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
```
```ini
# derive@.service — started ONLY by the capture's ExecStartPost (never also After= it)
[Unit]
Description=Rebuild derived data for slot %i
OnFailure=app-alert@%n.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=app
EnvironmentFile=/etc/app/app.env
ExecStart=/opt/app/.venv/bin/python -m app.rebuild --slot %i
# lock busy / inputs moved: retry next tick, don't page
SuccessExitStatus=75
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
# + the tenant's canonical/ and run_outputs/, granted by the 10-scope drop-in (§1)
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/app/locks /var/log/app
```
```ini
# report@.service — non-idempotent delivery: its own timer, ordered After= the chain
[Unit]
After=capture@%i.service
OnFailure=app-alert@%n.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=app
Group=app
# it composes its own messages
EnvironmentFile=/etc/app/app.env
# code also skips Sundays / stale data
ExecStart=/opt/app/.venv/bin/python -m app.report --slot %i
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
ReadWritePaths=/var/log/app
```
```ini
# report@morning.timer
[Timer]
OnCalendar=Mon..Sat *-*-* 10:30:00 Europe/Berlin
AccuracySec=1s
# never replay yesterday's report after a reboot
Persistent=false
```
Validate every spec at install: `systemd-analyze calendar "Mon..Sat *-*-* 10:30:00 Europe/Berlin"`,
and every unit with `systemd-analyze verify <unit>`. **Comments go on their own line**: systemd
treats `#` as a comment only at the start of a line, so `ProtectSystem=strict  # note` is an
invalid value that gets ignored — the sandbox silently disappears.

## §3 Alert template + stdlib notifier

```ini
# app-alert@.service — NO OnFailure here (no loops)
[Unit]
Description=Alert for %i
[Service]
Type=oneshot
EnvironmentFile=/etc/app/app.env
RuntimeDirectory=app-alerts
RuntimeDirectoryPreserve=yes
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/app/deploy/notify.py --unit %i --key %i
```
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""notify.py — stdlib only, so it works when the app's venv is what broke."""
import argparse, json, os, socket, subprocess, sys, time, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

COOLDOWN = int(os.environ.get("ALERT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS", "1800"))
STATE = Path(os.environ.get("RUNTIME_DIRECTORY", "/run/app-alerts"))


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--unit"); ap.add_argument("--key", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--message"); ap.add_argument("--clear", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    stamp = STATE / f"{a.key}.last"
    if a.clear:
        stamp.unlink(missing_ok=True); return 0
    if stamp.exists() and time.time() - stamp.stat().st_mtime < COOLDOWN:
        print(f"muted: {a.key} alerted within {COOLDOWN}s"); return 0
    text = a.message or tail_journal(a.unit)
    body = f"[{socket.gethostname()}] {a.unit or a.key}: {text}"[:1800]
    url = os.environ.get("ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL", "")
    if not url:
        print(f"ALERT NOT DELIVERED (no channel configured): {body}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 0                                    # loud, but never fail the alert unit itself
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps({"content": body}).encode(),
                                         headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
            urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
            STATE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); stamp.touch()
            print("delivered"); return 0
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            if e.code != 429:
                break
            time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
        except OSError:
            break
    print(f"ALERT NOT DELIVERED: {body}", file=sys.stderr)
    return 0


def tail_journal(unit: str | None) -> str:
    if not unit:
        return "failed"
    out = subprocess.run(["journalctl", "-u", unit, "-n", "15", "--no-pager", "-o", "cat"],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    return "failed:\n" + out[-1500:]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

## §4 Watchdog skeleton (function, not process)

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# tunnel_check.sh [--dry-run]
set -uo pipefail
dry=0; [ "${1:-}" = "--dry-run" ] && dry=1
state=/run/tunnel-watchdog; mkdir -p "$state"
# tun/wg links report state UNKNOWN, not UP: judge by an IPv4 address being present
healthy() { ip -4 -br addr show dev tun0 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $3}' | grep -q '^[0-9]\+\.'; }

command -v vpn-client >/dev/null || { echo "nothing to watch on this host"; exit 0; }
healthy && { notify --key tunnel --clear; exit 0; }
[ "$dry" -eq 1 ] && { echo "DRY RUN: tunnel down; would repair"; exit 0; }
if [ -f "$state/last-repair" ] && [ $(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$state/last-repair") )) -lt 600 ]; then
  echo "tunnel down; repaired <10 min ago; not repairing again"; journalctl -u vpn-client -n 20 --no-pager
  exit 1                                           # goes red (OnFailure alerts) with evidence
fi
touch "$state/last-repair"
start=$(date +%s)
systemctl restart vpn-client; sleep 90             # cheap first
healthy || { env -u APP_TOKEN vpn-client connect; sleep 240; }   # reliable second; no secrets to vendor bin
if healthy; then notify --key tunnel --message "tunnel restored in $(( $(date +%s) - start ))s"; exit 0; fi
notify --key tunnel-stuck --message "tunnel still down after restart + reconnect; needs a human"
exit 1
```

## §5 Log ceilings

```ini
# /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/app.conf
[Journal]
SystemMaxUse=200M
SystemMaxFileSize=50M
```
```
# /etc/logrotate.d/app
/var/log/app/*.log {
  daily
  rotate 14
  maxsize 100M
  compress
  missingok
  notifempty
  copytruncate
}
```

## §6 Unit-file test helpers

```python
import re


def section(text: str, name: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """(key, value) directives of ONE section, comments ignored."""
    m = re.search(rf"(?ms)^\[{re.escape(name)}\]\s*$(.*?)(?=^\[|\Z)", text)
    out = []
    for line in (m.group(1) if m else "").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line and not line.startswith(("#", ";")) and "=" in line:
            k, v = line.split("=", 1)
            # '#' mid-line is NOT a comment to systemd: the value is invalid and ignored
            check("#" not in v, f"[{name}] {k.strip()}: inline comment makes the value invalid")
            out.append((k.strip(), v.strip()))
    return out


units = {p.name: p.read_text() for p in Path("deploy").glob("*.service")}
for name, text in units.items():
    starts = re.findall(r"systemctl start --wait (\S+)", " ".join(v for k, v in section(text, "Service") if k == "ExecStartPost"))
    for child in starts:
        child_text = units.get(child.replace("%i", "@").split("@")[0] + "@.service", "")
        after = " ".join(v for k, v in section(child_text, "Unit") if k == "After")
        check(name.split("@")[0] not in after,
              f"{child} is started by {name} AND After= it — that deadlocks")
```

## §7 compose translation

```yaml
services:
  web:
    image: ghcr.io/you/app@sha256:...        # by digest
    read_only: true
    tmpfs: [/tmp]
    volumes:
      - app-locks:/var/lib/app/locks
      - app-logs:/var/log/app
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    mem_limit: 1g
    restart: on-failure
    env_file: [.env]                          # dev only; prod injects from the secret manager
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python", "-c", "import urllib.request;urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz')"]
      interval: 30s
      retries: 3
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: { max-size: "50m", max-file: "5" }
volumes: { app-locks: {}, app-logs: {} }
```
